tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: List the Argo CD applications Sidekick may read: name, project, destination (cluster and namespace), sync status, health, whether auto-sync is on, the revision deployed now, the revision the application was last compared with, when it last synced, and a link. Use it to find the application of a service, or to see which applications are out of sync or not healthy. Pass the application field of a result, as project/name, to the other tools.

limit.description: The most applications to return, 1 to 200. Default 50.

name.description: Only applications whose name matches this pattern, for example checkout-*. * matches any run of characters and ? one character.

state.description: Only applications in this state: out_of_sync, not_healthy (health is not Healthy), problem (out of sync or not healthy), or any. Default any.
